source: master goal: Codex is fallback only and must stay at or below 30 percent of daily AI-agent work.
basis: coordinator-logged daily agent work (state/ai-agent-reports.jsonl). Every status-agnostic entry inside windowHours counts as one unit of daily AI-agent work, regardless of how that entry was recorded.
computation: sharePct = round(100 * measuredAgentCount / totalCount, 1). Dispatch allowed only when sharePct <= maxSharePct. totalCount == 0 => the basis is unverified/UNKNOWN and is reported as such, never certified as a verified zero.
failClosed: Codex dispatch above the cap is refused with CODEX_QUOTA_EXCEEDED even when allowPaid is true; the measurement reuses the existing shared coordination log and does not create a second quota registry or worker.
rollback: Revert the enforcement call in scripts/master-coordinator.cjs#invokeCodex and restore this file from the previous commit; the merge-base is the rollback reference.
